description:
Change one segment without losing renders; only split spends
credits. Returns the changed segments.

set_prompts: write prompts verbatim, no AI rewrite. The renders stay as
they are: render the segment again to apply the new prompts.
set_continuation: make this segment's image continue an earlier one's
(same composition, only the change); render the image again.
rollback: restore one of the last 5 renders of the image or clip; the
current one takes its place, so it can be undone, and the prompt
editor's model stays as it is. split: cut into 2-4 parts; the
inheriting part keeps the prompts and renders; the others start empty
and get prompts written from their narration in the background (spends
credits), or give them prompts with set_prompts. Later segments
renumber: read the storyboard again before more edits.

action.description: set_prompts: image_prompt, video_prompt and/or media_queries; set_continuation: continues_from; rollback: what, optional index; split: offsets_ms, optional inherit_index

continues_from.description: set_continuation: an EARLIER segment number; 0 clears the link

index.description: rollback: which earlier render, 0 = the latest

inherit_index.description: split: the part (0-based) that keeps the prompts and renders

media_queries.description: set_prompts: searches for a real photo or B-roll

offsets_ms.description: split: 1-3 ascending cut points, in ms from the segment's start; word timings: voiceover_read action=blocks include_subtitle_data=true

video_prompt.description: set_prompts: the motion used when the image is animated

what.description: rollback: restore the image or the clip

name: segment_edit
title: Edit a segment
